The plate looks like a side plate of about 22 cm. It holds roughly 3 to 4 strips of cooked bacon, which appear well done and dark.

Each strip is about 18-20 cm long. Cooked bacon runs roughly 8 g per strip, or about 10 g for thicker cuts. The strips here look thick-cut and a bit curled, so I'll use about 9 g each. The count is either 3 strips (one at the top, one across the middle, one at the bottom left) or possibly 4, since the bottom-left one may be two overlapping strips. I'll take 4 strips at about 9 g each, which comes to about 36 g.

Cooked bacon is about 540 kcal per 100 g, so 36 g is about 195 kcal.
